name: Entry Visa / Visitor Status

value.note: Nationals of countries on Barbados' published visa-required list must obtain an Entry Visa before travel: single-entry (one entry within a 3-month window) US$107, or multiple-entry (numerous entries within a 6-month window) US$211. Nationals not on that list may enter visa-free as visitors.

requirements.blocker_text: If your nationality requires an entry visa, you must obtain one (single- or multiple-entry) before travelling to Barbados.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for and obtain the appropriate Entry Visa before travel.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a return or onward ticket and evidence of the ability to support yourself for the duration of the stay, plus a specified intended address in Barbados.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a return/onward ticket and documented evidence of financial support.

evidence_required.document: Passport valid for the duration of the trip
Completed online Immigration and Customs form (available from 72 hours before arrival)
Notarised parental consent letter for unaccompanied minors or minors travelling with a non-parent

outcome.duration_length: length of stay granted on entry is at the immigration officer's discretion; not specified on the official pages fetched in this pass

sources.title: Barbados Immigration Department (immigration.gov.bb) -- Visa Requirement Information
Barbados Immigration Department (immigration.gov.bb) -- Visitor status entry requirements

notes: FIRST BARBADOS ROUTE, part of this country's initial build. HONEST SOURCING GAP: neither official page fetched in this pass states the actual length of stay granted to a visitor on entry (many Commonwealth Caribbean states grant up to 28 days to 6 months at officer discretion, and allow extension applications through the Immigration Department, but this was not independently confirmed for Barbados specifically in this pass) -- duration_length is left descriptive rather than a specific invented number, and renewable is set true based on general regional practice, not a source fetched in this pass; both should be revisited if a clearer source surfaces. The Entry Visa fees (US$107 single-entry / US$211 multiple-entry) govern permission to travel to Barbados at all for nationals who need one, not the length of stay once admitted -- these are two different things and the source page does not fully separate them. family_can_work is set false as a placeholder based on general visitor-visa convention across this dataset, not a Barbados-specific confirmation.
